biggest.title: Louisville Ladder Recalls Over One Million Attic Stairway Ladders Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard
biggest.product: Louisville, Featherlite, Lite & Century Attic Stairway Ladders with gas struts
biggest.unitsRaw: 1,770,000 (In addition, about 13,054 were sold in Canada)
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Attic Stairway Ladder with gas struts (Location of Brand Marking)
biggest.retailerText: The Home Depot, Lowe's, Do It Best, Orgill, and other retailers nationwide and on-line at Amazon.com from November 2012 through July 2026 for between $170 and $600.
biggest.hazard: The bolts on the attic stairway ladders can break while in use, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fall hazard.

biggest.title: Conair Recalls Over One Million Cuisinart Grill Brushes Due to Ingestion Hazard
biggest.retailerText: Burlington, TJ Maxx and Ross stores and online including Amazon.com and Cuisinart.com from June 2009 through March 2026 for between $8 and $20.
biggest.hazard: Small metal wire bristles can detach from the brushes and stick to the grill or food, posing an ingestion hazard and risk of serious internal injuries that could require surgery.

biggest.title: Thrasio Recalls Angry Orange Enzyme Stain Removers Due to Risk of Exposure to Bacteria
biggest.unitsRaw: About 1,500,000 (In addition, about 43,700 were sold in Canada)
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Orange Twist Angry Orange Enzyme Stain Remover
biggest.retailerText: Walmart, Target, The Home Depot, Meijer, Staples, TJ Maxx and other major retailers nationwide and online at Amazon.com, Walmart.com, Target.com, AngryOrange.com and Chewy.com from March 2019 through December 2025 for between $4 and $60.
biggest.hazard: The recalled products can contain bacteria, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa, an environmental organism found widely in soil and water. People with weakened immune systems, external medical devices, or underlying lung conditions who are exposed to Pseudomonas aeruginosa face a risk of serious infection that may require medical treatment. The bacteria can enter the body if inhaled, through the eyes, or through a break in the skin. People with healthy immune systems are usually not affected by bacteria.

biggest.title: Bayer Recalls 6 mL Size Afrin Original Nasal Spray Bottles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Illness from Child Poisoning; Violates Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging
biggest.product: Travel Size Afrin® Original Nasal Spray 6 mL Bottles
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Afrin® 6mL Size Original Nasal Spray Bottles (Front of Bottle)
biggest.retailerText: Retailers such as convenience stores and travel hubs including airports from September 2024 to April 2026 for about $7 to $9.
biggest.hazard: The 6 mL nasal sprays contain an imidazoline, which must be in child-resistant packaging or meet the labeling requirements for non-complying packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The 6 mL nasal spray's packaging is not child-resistant nor bears the required labeling statement, posing a risk of serious injury or illness from poisoning, if the contents are swallowed by young children.

biggest.title: E Mishan Recalls Granitestone Diamond Pro Blue Stainless Sauté Pans Due to Impact and Burn Hazards
biggest.product: Granitestone Diamond Pro Blue Sauté Pans
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Granitestone Diamond Pro Blue Stainless 10” & 11.5” Sauté Pans
biggest.retailerText: The recalled sauté pans were sold in stores at Costco and online at Costco.com, Walmart.com, and Amazon.com from August 2021 through February 2026 for about $40.
biggest.hazard: The metal cap on the screw that connects the sauté pan to the handle can become detached and forcefully eject when heated, posing impact and burn hazards to consumers.

biggest.title: Wagner Spray Tech Recalls 900 Series Power Steamers Due to Burn Hazard
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Wagner Model 905e Auto Steamer, pictured with included accessories
biggest.retailerText: The Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Target, HSN and QVC, and online at Amazon.com and www.wagnerspraytech.com from November 2018 to March 2026 for between $130 and $200.
biggest.hazard: The attached hose can get excessively hot and the nozzle/gun can expel hot water during use and after the trigger is engaged, posing a serious burn hazard to consumers.

biggest.title: Dupray USA Recalls Neat Steam Cleaners Due to Risk of Burn Hazards or Serious Injury
biggest.unitsRaw: About 651,145 (In addition, about 96,530 were sold in Canada)
biggest.retailerText: Online at dupray.com and in stores and online at Home Depot, Lowe's, Macy's, Walmart, Amazon.com and other retailers nationwide from April 2018 through December 2025 for about $150.
biggest.hazard: The steam cleaner's boiler can rupture if it is overfilled, corroded and the pressure release valve malfunctions, posing risk of burn hazards or serious injury to users or bystanders.

biggest.title: Greenworks Tools Recalls 24V and 48V Kobalt Yard Power Tools with USB-C Batteries Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire Hazard
biggest.product: Kobalt 24V and 48V Trimmers, Blowers, Mowers, Chainsaws and Pruning Saws with USB-C Batteries
biggest.retailerText: Lowe's stores nationwide and online at Lowes.com from January 2026 through May 2026 for between $20 and $482.
biggest.hazard: Charging the lithium-ion batteries through the USB-C port, while the batteries are inserted in the yard power tools can cause the batteries to short-circuit, posing a risk of serious injury from fire hazard.

biggest.title: Joyin Expands Recall of Sloosh Dive Sticks Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Impalement; Violate Federal Dive Sticks Ban
biggest.unitsRaw: About 404,000 (Joyin previously recalled 254,000 dive sticks on June 11, 2026, which are included in the total of 404,000)
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Sloosh Dive Sticks, Model 40041 (front of box)
biggest.retailerText: Model 40041 - sold on Amazon.com, Temu.com, Wayfair.com, Target.com and SHEIN.com from February 2019 through October 2025 for between $17 and $22. Model 40003 - sold on Amazon.com, Target.com and SHEIN.com from January 2017 through December 2025 for between $14 and $16. Model 16154 - sold on Amazon.com and Target.com from October 2023 through December 2025 for between $10 and $15.
biggest.hazard: The recalled dive sticks violate the federal dive sticks ban because they exceeded the compress limit, posing an impalement hazard. In shallow water, children may fall or land on a dive stick, resulting in serious piercing injuries. Facial and eye injuries are also possible when children attempt to retrieve the sticks underwater.

biggest.title: Vitaquest International Recalls Multiple Iron Supplement Bottles and Packets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Poisoning to Young Children; Violates Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging
biggest.product: Various Brands of Iron-Containing Dietary Supplements
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Arey, Not Today, Grey (180ct) - front
biggest.retailerText: Credo Beauty, Erewhon, Healf, Nutrition World, The Vitamin Shoppe, Fullscript, Ulta Beauty stores nationwide, medical practitioners' offices, brands' websites and Amazon.com from April 2023 through February 2026 for between $13 and $130 depending on brand and size.
biggest.hazard: The dietary supplements contain iron, which must be in child-resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The packaging of the supplements is not child-resistant, posing a risk of serious injury or death from poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children.
